calendar.title: Google Calendar
calendar.intro: Show scheduled and completed maintenance on a shared Google Calendar.
calendar.not_configured_title: Google Calendar sync isn't set up on this server
calendar.not_configured_body: Set these environment variables on the Homebox container, then restart it:
calendar.redirect_uri_hint: Add this authorized redirect URI to your Google OAuth client:
calendar.broken_body: Google rejected the saved credentials, so syncing is paused. Reconnect to resume.
calendar.calendar_hint: Only calendars you can edit are listed. Homebox only ever changes events it created.
calendar.include_completed: Keep completed maintenance on the calendar (marked ✅)
calendar.include_project_steps: Include project steps that have a due date
calendar.no_calendar_chosen: Choose a calendar to start syncing.
calendar.disconnect_body: Homebox will forget the Google connection. It never deletes your calendar.
calendar.disconnect_remove: Also remove the events Homebox created
calendar.disconnected_skipped: Disconnected. Events couldn't be removed because the connection was broken.
calendar.toast_state: The connection link expired. Try connecting again.
calendar.feed_intro: A private, read-only link you can subscribe to from Apple Calendar, Outlook or any calendar app. Anyone with the link can see your maintenance schedule.
calendar.feed_active: Feed link active since {when}. The link is only shown when it is created.
calendar.feed_url_once: Copy this link now. For your security it won't be shown again.
calendar.feed_copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Select the link and copy it manually.
calendar.feed_rotated: Feed link rotated. The old link no longer works.
calendar.feed_rotate_body: A new link replaces the old one. Calendars subscribed to the old link stop updating until you re-subscribe.
calendar.feed_revoke_body: The link stops working immediately. You can create a new one later.
